criteria.justification: The diff uses only `addReview(productId: $productId, rating: $rating, body: $body)` with Review fields id/rating/body/createdAt/author, avoiding the flagged fabrications (no reviewText/title, no rating enum, no update/deleteReview, no invented reviews argument).
The mutation is invoked exactly as `addReview(productId: ..., rating: ..., body: ...)`.
The operation declares `$productId: ID!` and passes it as the productId argument identifying the product.
The variable is declared `$rating: Int!` and typed as `rating: number` in TypeScript.
`$body: String` is nullable and the TS signature uses `body?: string` with `body: body ?? null`.
The selection set contains only id, rating, body, createdAt, and author — all listed Review fields.
The request is sent with `{ authenticated: true }`, routing through the client's authenticated path as documented in the README.
